bio: Canadian-American actor and businessman known for Deadpool, Free Guy, and owning Aviation Gin and Wrexham AFC.
name: Ryan Reynolds
title: Actor & Entrepreneur
whyCool: Reynolds is basically if the internet became a person. His marketing genius turned Aviation Gin and Mint Mobile into cultural phenomena, and his Twitter game is unmatched. He fought for over a decade to make Deadpool happen, proving that persistence (and R-rated superhero jokes) pays off.

bio: Former NFL quarterback, 2016 NFL MVP, led the Atlanta Falcons to Super Bowl LI. Known as 'Matty Ice' for his clutch performances.
name: Matt Ryan
title: NFL Quarterback
whyCool: Matt earned the nickname 'Matty Ice' for being one of the most clutch quarterbacks in the league. 2016 MVP, led one of the greatest offenses in NFL history. Yeah, we don't talk about that Super Bowl, but the man's career numbers speak for themselves.

bio: Canadian actor known for his roles in The Notebook, Drive, La La Land, and Barbie. Also half of the musical duo Dead Man's Bones.
name: Ryan Gosling
title: Actor & Musician
whyCool: Gosling is the rare actor who can do romantic leads, intense dramas, and comedic roles with equal mastery. From making women swoon in The Notebook to becoming a meme legend with 'Hey Girl,' he's got range. Plus, he learned piano for La La Land and did his own singing. The man commits.

bio: Former MLB pitcher who holds the record for most career strikeouts (5,714) and no-hitters (7). Played for 27 seasons.
name: Nolan Ryan
title: Baseball Legend
whyCool: Nolan is an absolute unit of baseball history. 7 no-hitters. 5,714 strikeouts. He pitched until he was 46 years old and was still throwing 95+ mph. Once beat up a batter who charged the mound. The Ryan Express doesn't stop.

bio: American media personality and producer. Host of American Idol, Live with Kelly and Ryan, and his iHeartRadio morning show.
name: Ryan Seacrest
title: TV & Radio Host
whyCool: Seacrest basically invented the modern entertainment hustle. The man hosts multiple shows, runs a production company, and still does a daily radio show. His New Year's Eve countdown is a national institution. Love him or hate him, the work ethic is undeniable.

bio: Founder of Messari, the leading crypto market intelligence platform. Previously co-founded Digital Currency Group and was Managing Director at CoinDesk, where he launched the annual Consensus conference. MIT Sloan MBA. Known on crypto Twitter as @taborasaurus before rebranding.
name: Ryan Selkis
title: Crypto Entrepreneur & Founder
whyCool: Selkis basically built the Bloomberg Terminal for crypto. When the industry was pure chaos and speculation, he created Messari to bring real data, research, and transparency to digital assets. Love him or hate him (and crypto Twitter has strong opinions), he's been one of the most influential voices pushing for legitimacy in the space. Also founded the Consensus conference which became the industry's biggest annual gathering.

bio: American professional boxer known as "KingRy". WBC interim lightweight champion. One of the most followed boxers on social media with 26M+ Instagram followers.
name: Ryan Garcia
title: Professional Boxer
whyCool: Garcia brought boxing back to the mainstream for Gen Z. His hand speed is insane, his knockouts are viral, and he talks trash like a prime Floyd. At 25, he KO'd Devin Haney in one of the biggest upsets in recent boxing history.

bio: Welsh football icon who spent his entire 24-year career at Manchester United. Most decorated player in English football history with 13 Premier League titles.
name: Ryan Giggs
title: Football Legend
whyCool: Giggs is Manchester United. 963 appearances, 13 league titles, 2 Champions Leagues. He played at the top level from age 17 to 40. His 1999 FA Cup semi-final goal against Arsenal is one of the greatest in football history.

bio: American YouTuber with 15M+ subscribers known for creative challenge videos. His "Penny Challenge" series went massively viral in 2022.
name: Ryan Trahan
title: YouTuber & Creator
whyCool: Trahan proved you can make wholesome content that still gets millions of views. His penny-to-LA series raised $1.4M for charity while being genuinely entertaining. He makes YouTube feel personal again.

bio: Co-founder of Chewy (sold for $3.35B) and Chairman of GameStop. Central figure in the 2021 GameStop short squeeze.
name: Ryan Cohen
title: Entrepreneur & Investor
whyCool: Cohen built Chewy from nothing into a pet retail giant, then became the face of the most insane stock market event of the decade. His cryptic tweets move markets. The ultimate "meme stock" chairman who actually knows how to build companies.

bio: American actor known for Cruel Intentions, Crash, and Flags of Our Fathers. 90s teen heartthrob who transitioned to serious dramatic roles.
name: Ryan Phillippe
title: Actor
whyCool: Phillippe was THE guy in the late 90s. Cruel Intentions made him iconic. He's quietly had one of the more interesting careers, going from teen movies to Clint Eastwood war films.

bio: Colombian reggaeton artist from Medellín. Started by busking on the streets, now a major Latin music star signed to Sony Music. Known for hits with Peso Pluma and his streetwise authenticity.
name: Ryan Castro
title: Reggaeton Artist
whyCool: Ryan Castro is the real deal - he went from busking on the streets of Medellín to selling out Barclays Center. His debut album El Cantante del Ghetto is a love letter to his hometown. Had a Billboard Hot 100 hit with Peso Pluma and just won a $2M lawsuit against his old label. The streets made him and he never forgot it.

bio: Software engineer and entrepreneur. Creator of alltheryans.com. Building things with AI.
name: Ryan Cwynar
title: Creator of All The Ryans
whyCool: The man who had the vision to catalog all the Ryans. Someone had to do it.

bio: Sales leader at Curv Group. Founder of Zen Growth and reserv. Helps brands create massive impact with custom products.
name: Ryan Humphries
title: Sales Director & Entrepreneur
whyCool: A Ryan who knows how to close deals and build businesses. Multiple founder with a 7-figure exit under his belt.

bio: American filmmaker who directed Black Panther, Creed, and Fruitvale Station.
name: Ryan Coogler
title: Film Director & Producer
whyCool: Built one of the highest-grossing films by a Black director. Black Panther was a cultural phenomenon.

bio: Lead singer of OneRepublic and one of the most successful songwriters in pop music. 3x Grammy winner for Album of the Year.
name: Ryan Tedder
title: Singer, Songwriter & Producer
whyCool: Half of the biggest pop songs have his fingerprints. Invisible hitmaker behind Beyonce, Adele, Taylor Swift.

bio: Creator of nigahiga, one of the original YouTube stars. First person ever to hit 2M and 3M subscribers. Held most subscribed for 675 days.
name: Ryan Higa
title: YouTube Pioneer & Comedian
whyCool: Helped define what YouTube could be before it was mainstream. A true pioneer of the creator economy.

bio: Star of Ryans World YouTube channel, which he started at age 3. 40M subscribers, 62 billion views. Highest-paid YouTuber 2018-2020.
name: Ryan Kaji
title: YouTube Star & Child Entertainer
whyCool: A kid named Ryan became the most-watched child on the internet. Love it or hate it, objectively famous.

bio: Co-founded Bolt, a one-click checkout startup. Stanford dropout who became the youngest billionaire before the company crashed from 11B to 300M valuation.
name: Ryan Breslow
title: Tech Entrepreneur
whyCool: Wild ride from dorm room to billionaire to SEC investigation. Peak startup chaos energy.

bio: American software engineer who created Node.js, the JavaScript runtime that revolutionized server-side development, and later Deno, a secure TypeScript/JavaScript runtime addressing Node's shortcomings.
name: Ryan Dahl
title: Creator of Node.js & Deno
whyCool: Changed how the entire world builds web servers. His JSConf 2009 talk introducing Node.js is legendary — he showed you could build fast, scalable servers with JavaScript. Then had the humility to say "I regret some decisions" and built Deno to fix them. The rare engineer who disrupts himself.

bio: American billionaire who co-founded Qualtrics from his family basement, grew it to an $8B acquisition by SAP, then took it public. Owns the Utah Jazz (NBA) and Utah Mammoth (NHL).
name: Ryan Smith
title: Co-founder of Qualtrics & Owner of Utah Jazz
whyCool: Built a billion-dollar company while still in college, dropped out, came back to finish his degree 12 years later. Now owns multiple pro sports teams. The definition of playing the long game.

bio: Got hired as Uber first employee by replying to Travis Kalanick tweet with just: here is a tip. email me :). Became CEO, then COO as Uber scaled to a $70B IPO. Now runs Saltwater, his family office, from Hawaii.
name: Ryan Graves
title: First CEO of Uber & Founder of Saltwater
whyCool: Landed one of the most legendary jobs in tech history with a cheeky tweet. Turned that into billions. Now lives in Kauai with his family. Absolute legend move.

bio: Started importing from China on eBay at 17. Built Flexport into an $8B freight and supply chain company. Known for his viral Twitter thread during the 2021 port crisis that reached the California Governor.
name: Ryan Petersen
title: Founder & CEO of Flexport
whyCool: Took on the ancient, unsexy world of freight shipping and made it a tech company. When the supply chain broke, he literally tweeted solutions that got implemented. Actions > words.

bio: Founded Product Hunt in 2013 as a side project, grew it into the go-to launchpad for new products. Sold to AngelList in 2016. Now invests in early-stage startups through Weekend Fund.
name: Ryan Hoover
title: Founder of Product Hunt & Weekend Fund
whyCool: Built the place where the entire tech world launches their products. Every founder knows Product Hunt. He literally created a new category of discovery platform.

bio: Canadian entrepreneur who started his first business in high school. Founded Hootsuite in 2008, grew it to 18+ million users and the dominant social media management platform. His fifth startup.
name: Ryan Holmes
title: Founder of Hootsuite
whyCool: Serial founder who kept at it until he hit a massive winner. Hootsuite became the verb for managing social media. Fifth time was the charm.

bio: Legal tech entrepreneur who built a unicorn from his basement. Filevine serves 6,000 customers and 100,000+ legal professionals.
name: Ryan Anderson
title: Co-founder & CEO, Filevine
whyCool: Went from practicing lawyer coding in his basement to running Utahs largest-ever financed startup. Created 30-40 millionaires at the company. Mentored by Ryan Smith—proof that Ryans help Ryans.

bio: 25-year tech entrepreneur who built and sold DropSend, Carsonified, and Treehouse. Educated 1M+ students in coding through Treehouse.
name: Ryan Carson
title: Serial Founder & CEO
whyCool: Three successful exits across three different decades. Built Treehouse into the go-to learn-to-code platform before selling in 2021. EY Entrepreneur of the Year. The rare founder who keeps shipping.
